auth_capability: private owned auth.json snapshot only; values neither printed nor published

retry_policy.contract: A scheduled call with a v11 retryable failure or a nonzero runner authentication-error envelope is retried once in a freshly prepared identical workspace at the same schedule position. Every attempt and retry reason is recorded; the final attempt is scored. A scoreable output is never retried. Authentication-error output is omitted from reports to avoid credential leakage. A Codex unexpected tool or item in the tools-disabled event stream is retryable once; a repeated event remains unscoreable and fail-closed.

abort_policy: Stop before another cell after exhausted auth/capacity; halt matrix on any incomplete arm, integrity failure, or 12h deadline. No model/identity switch or cell replacement.
claim_limits: Public previously observed AI-authored development corpus
One model and CLI identity; provider backend not attested
Zero tools does not prove scanner causal benefit
Scientific comparison is separate from release readiness

preflight_attempt_1.reason: Historical strict schema omitted current #8c vocabulary. The v22-only schema was registered before scoring; historical schema was preserved.

admission_attempt_2.purpose: Unscored schema and CLI compatibility admission, retained before v22-only exhausted-identity stop was added.

admission_attempt_3.purpose: Final evaluated harness admission; every arm had strict-schema scoreable output, zero-tools stream validation, immutable inputs and raw parse/rescore agreement.

offline_contract_runtime: Original local Python3.9 invocation; v8 zip(strict=True) contract rerun passed on repository-supported Python3.12.14. All model calls keep the same original Python3.9.6 harness runtime.

event_stream_evidence.limitation: Original CLI JSON event streams are not retained; independent retrospective per-call tool recount is unavailable. model_tool_surface none is execution-contract provenance, not raw tool-count attestation.
